blocks.text: Collaborative tools let several people work on the plan at once with real-time feedback. Opening a bakery with a friend who bakes, you can both edit the same document in Google Drive or Dropbox Paper: your partner writes about products and recipes while you write the marketing plan and financial forecast. Comment and suggestion modes let you propose changes without altering the text, and version history lets you track changes and go back to earlier drafts.

blocks.prompt: Why is version history useful in a shared plan?
blocks.explanation: If a change is wrong or deleted by mistake, you can see who changed what and restore an earlier version.

items: Collaboration tools: edit together, comment, suggest, track versions (Google Drive, Dropbox Paper).
